gallery.title: File:PS 43 Jonas Bronck School.jpg
gallery.description:
PS 43, the Jonas Bronck School, is located at 165 Brown Place, from East 135th to East 136th streets, in the Mott Haven section of the Bronx, New York City.  It was built in 1906 in the Renaissance Revival style and is named for the first European settler and namesake of the borough.
According to the NYC Schools website, PS 43 has an enrollment of 489 students in grades preK to 5th.  In contrast, a NY Tribune article dated Nov. 6, 1921, stated that the school then had an enrollment of 3,335 children and that it operated with a double-session.
categories: June 2016 in the Bronx, New York City
Neo-Renaissance architecture in New York City
